reviews.author: Robert Davis
reviews.text: Jeff & Josh are great! They are very knowledgeable and fair priced for their repairs. I had a new catalytic converter installed. They did a great job with the replacement, and it didn’t cost me an arm & a leg. The also replaced a high pressure fuel pump! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND A & A Auto for your vehicle maintenance and repair work!

reviews.author: Kate
reviews.text: 2 of the best people around and I would happily go out of my way to have them work on my cars. Super friendly and always informative, will answer all of your questions honestly and do everything they can to help you out.

reviews.author: Ruth McManus
reviews.text: I have used these guys as my mechanic now for a few years, and they are always very honest and fair. I also recently used them to get my late father’s car running again and they took great care of the car and got it back in fantastic shape. Can’t say enough good things about this shop.

reviews.author: Shannon Duckworth
reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about A&A Automotive! My Jeep’s acceleration stopped working just up the road and I barely was able to make it to their parking lot. They came right out to run some tests and diagnose the problem. Josh quickly ordered the parts and had the repairs completed before the day was even over. They were such a blessing and saved the day, and I cannot thank them enough for their kindness, knowledge, professionalism, and willingness to make the repairs so quickly. We have been in search of an honest and reliable mechanic and I can say without a doubt that A&A Automotive is the place we will support from now on!

reviews.author: Ileana Robinson
reviews.text: Embarrassingly enough, I know absolutely NOTHING about cars. Finding A&A was a Godsend. Prices are fair but most importantly, I feel welcome here. I don't feel like an inconvenience. I don't feel like I'm being taken for every penny. I don't feel like I'm being lied to or taken advantage of because of my lack of knowledge. They answer anytime I call with questions. They are accommodating when I say I have to be gone by a certain time for the school pick-up line. They give off a sense of kindness and sincerity and they get the job done. If you're anything like me, I'd trust Jeff and Josh at A&A for THE BEST customer service and prices.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Jensen
reviews.text: Jeff and Josh have been so kind to us. They are the best referral we have ever received from a friend. We have older vehicles and they are very patient with us. They will be our “go to” for anything mechanical. You can trust them!! Jacqueline & Jim Jensen

reviews.author: Susan Gordon
reviews.text: Jeff did a great job on my Pathfinder brakes. He is honest and no one can beat his prices. They will definitely be my go to for all of my needed repairs!!

reviews.author: Joan McCarver
reviews.text: This is the best place to take your car for all of your service needs. They are honest hard working guys!!! They go above and beyond to help you! Thank y’all so much for taking care of my car. I will never go anywhere else! If I could post 10 stars I would!

reviews.author: Leslie Moore Preslar (Crazy Red)
reviews.text: I took my car in for a new set of tires and a tune up. I got a good deal on my tires and only needed an oil change. The plugs were still good and the air filter was barely dirty so it didn't need changing either. Jeff does honest work & good fair prices. He could have ripped me off and didn't. I would recommend them to everyone I know. Jeff has worked on my cars & my mother's cars for at least the past 10 years and we have never had an issue. Thanks Jeff for always being honest.

reviews.author: Chuck Garmon
reviews.text: Extremely professional with down home feel of caring, politeness and informative. I was first referred to them from a friend who just continued to rave about their great service. Somewhat hesitant, I tried them. My friend was not exaggerating at all! Great service reasonably priced with a comfortable and trusting atmosphere! Chuck

reviews.author: Dr. Everett Case
reviews.text: Knowledgeable, fair pricing, and friendly. My wife and I both bring our cars here. I highly recommend A&A for everything automotive.

reviews.author: Michael Bentley
reviews.text: A&A auto is one of the best around in my opinion. Why? First Al and Jeff know how to relate and communicate with their customers ie if you tell them something is broke or making a noise that is exactly what they will fix and not something you didn't ask for, rarely will they tell you something else needs to be done. If they do you probably should get it done) Secondly they are honest, reasonable in their rates and a business based on integrity. Thirdly and most important they know how to work on cars. I've been doing business there for over 10 years. Thanks Al, Jeff and David you are the best.

reviews.author: Christine Trivette
reviews.text: These guys are wonderful. They do great work, are honest, and treat you well. Absolutely recommend their services.

reviews.author: jeanne scott
reviews.text: Can't say enough good things about these guys. Polite, professional and knowledgeable. Had to do some diagnosing on my 2003 Chevy, and I wasn't charged an arm and a leg. Kept me informed as well. Definitely recommend A&A Automotive!

reviews.author: Candis King
reviews.text: This place is the best in all of Gaston County. The most knowledgeable, fair pricing and great service. These guys are worth all your time and money.

reviews.author: Cyndi Brooks
reviews.text: Excellent, honest, great service!! Very dependable family own business. Would recommend to everyone.

reviews.author: Renee Hales
reviews.text: My family has relied on A&A for several years now. We've never had a bad experience. We've never left feeling like we were taken advantage of. We appreciate having people like this that we can count on.

reviews.author: Mark Ewing
reviews.text: A&A has always been great. Affordable prices, low stress, and straightforward with the services that you’ll need. Will always recommend.

reviews.author: Jennifer pruitt
reviews.text: Have take both of our vehicles there to be fixed and Jeff did a phenomenal job . Was very straightforward about what the problem was and the cost it would be . Would highly recommend them for your automotive servicing needs !!!!

reviews.author: Regina Taylor
reviews.text: A and A has worked on my cars for over year. We have never had a problem with any of the repairs. We had a motor rebuilt and Jeff called to make sure it was running Ok. I have never had repair shop to do that .

reviews.author: Jennifer Parker
reviews.text: Highly recommended A & A Automotive! It’s a peace of mind having a trusted mechanic like Jeff and his son Josh. Very honest, friendly and trustworthy service.

reviews.author: Beth Wallin
reviews.text: Excellent service and great prices! Jeff services our work and personal vehicles. I highly recommend Jeff and his crew for fair pricing and dependable service of your vehicles!

reviews.author: Andy Starnes
reviews.text: One of the best places in the area to have your vehicle repaired!! The Mechanics are super nice and very helpful and ""WILL NOT"" try to rob you on the pricing!! 5 stars from me!!

reviews.author: Samantha Phillips
reviews.text: Thank you so much to Jeff and Josh for fixing my daughter's car so quickly. We so appreciate your kindness and fairness. Found a new place of service!

reviews.author: Rosa Marsh
reviews.text: They did a wonderful job fixing the A/C on my truck. Very reasonably priced, too. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Michelle Gorczynski
reviews.text: Great service, fair pricing and an all around great experience! Thank you for being great at what you do and just all around good people!!!

reviews.author: Stephon
reviews.text: Took well over a month to fix my clutch , 2nd time they fixed it they changed a completely wrong part and my car would not even make it up their tiny hill ... don’t recommend 1/10

reviews.author: Big Diesel
reviews.text: Having worked in mechanics shops and done most of all my mechanical work, when I can't get it, these fellas will, I know what it takes and these guys got it!!!
